svg.text: The sentence this sheet licenses: 'A vehicle's claim is carried by the same

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: guarantee as a $2B transfer on this chain — up to the waterline (BP-001).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Above it, the guarantee is ours, and it is measured (BP-403).'

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 1. An identity operation is a transaction. It enters the same mempool, is ordered by the same validators, pays the same fee market and reaches the same

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: finality as a transfer of value. The ledger cannot tell them apart.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2. The fiat value a given chain secures (X) is a parameter, not a thesis result: insert it with a dated source when citing. The structure of the inheritance

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 3. What is NOT inherited is drawn on the right. Those are the application layer's own obligations — and they are the ones this repository measures (BP-403).
